label: Chainlink Data Streams requirements
summary: Atomic EVM-only requirements for Data Streams report verification. Select it through --chainlink-product data-streams; credentials and heavy verification stay outside v4 callbacks.
requiredFacts: Exact verifier role, address and runtime-code hash, feed ID, report schema and version
Valid-from, expiry, observation-age and future bounds plus maximum report bytes and verification gas
Billing route, market-status and ripcord policies with explicit authority and recovery
Backend-only credential boundary with no keys, subscriptions or private endpoints in client, bytecode, logs or public evidence
Report verification outside PoolManager callbacks and rejection before value effects
requiredFiles: Content-addressed EVM-only Chainlink provider profile selecting Data Streams
Verifier deployment evidence, runtime-code hash, dependency lock and report schema
Backend report-fetch and onchain verification source with credential boundary
Freshness, size, gas, billing, market-status and ripcord policies
requiredTests: Wrong verifier, runtime hash, feed ID, report schema, report version and target chain
Not-yet-valid, expired, stale, future, oversized, malformed and replayed report
Verification gas and report-byte bounds before value effects
Credential leakage through browser bundles, bytecode, manifests, logs and public evidence
No heavy report verification inside a PoolManager callback
risks: Leaked credentials can expose paid data access or operational authority
Wrong report schema or feed ID can authenticate semantically unrelated data
Unbounded report size or verification gas can break liveness
A structurally valid report path can be overstated as current verifier deployment or provider availability
